_comment: Aggregate grid figures for the dashboard. Aggregates only — named per-project allocations are deliberately not recorded. Update when AESO publishes new numbers; the daily change-watch will flag when its large-load page moves.
notes: The 1,200 MW interim cap runs through 2028 and is reported as fully allocated.
Named per-project allocations are not recorded here — only aggregates.
A bridging approach allows limited early connection under strict reliability conditions, including obligations to reduce consumption when the grid requires it.
